meta.name: Close Enough
meta.description: Una pareja casada millennial, que tienen poco más de treinta años, intentan no perder la onda mientras hacen malabarismos con desafíos cotidianos como la paternidad, la amistad, el robo de jamones, los payasos strippers y la elección de la guardería adecuada.

videos.overview: La adicción de Emily a las casas en venta es una vía de escape, aunque sea temporal.

videos.overview: In a last-ditch attempt to prove they can still party, Emily, Josh, and Alex follow Bridgette to a hot new nightclub.

videos.title: Room Parents
videos.overview: When Josh volunteers at Candice's school, Emily becomes suspicious that another parent is trying to seduce him.

videos.title: Skate Dad
videos.overview: Struggling to bond with Candice, Josh goes all out to become the world's best skate dad.

videos.title: 100% No Stress Day
videos.overview: The roommates work together to give Emily a stress-free day but are promptly sidetracked by shady characters from Alex's past.

videos.overview: Emily tries to roll with the "cool moms" at Candice's school, while Josh and Alex help Randy find his mom.

videos.title: Golden Gamer
videos.overview: When Josh attempts to finish a video game, he must confront an inner demon. Alex tries to win his students' respect.

videos.title: So Long Boys
videos.overview: When Emily has a pregnancy scare, Josh considers a vasectomy as Alex embraces fatherhood.

videos.overview: Josh finally sells a video game and gets to experience how the other half lives, while birthday girl Bridgette is forced to get a real job.

videos.overview: While Josh and Emily try to rekindle their relationship, Alex acts as Bridgette's wingman on a horrifying double date.

videos.title: Sauceface

videos.title: Houseguest from Hell

videos.title: Joint Break
videos.overview: Pearle makes new friends in a water aerobics class who turns out to have a sinister secret.

videos.title: Cyber Matrix
videos.overview: Alex buys his first smartphone, which seduces him into a digital fantasy world.

videos.title: Haunted Couch
videos.overview: Bridgette is sick of unreliable guys who "ghost" her until she falls for an actual ghost.

videos.title: Man Up
videos.overview: After Josh abandons his family in the face of danger, he asks Pearle to train him to be brave.

videos.title: Handy
videos.overview: Randy discovers his true calling while stranded on a deserted island.

videos.title: Birthdaze
videos.overview: Tired of children’s birthday parties, Josh and Emily try to make Candice’s party more exciting for adults.

videos.title: Time Hooch
videos.overview: Alex and Josh travel back in time to save Alex and Bridgette’s marriage.

videos.title: World's Greatest Teacher

videos.title: Where'd You Go, Bridgette?
videos.overview: While Pearle helps Bridgette break her phone addiction, the others mistakenly believe Bridgette has been abducted.

videos.overview: To market his steamy novel of Viking erotica, Alex recruits Pearle to pose as the book’s author.

videos.title: Men Rock!
videos.overview: Bridgette and Emily discover they are beloved rock stars in a foreign country.

videos.title: Secret Horse
videos.overview: A horse gets loose during a windstorm and teaches the gang to dream again.

videos.title: Where the Buffalo Roam
videos.overview: After a major windfall, Josh and Emily decide to take the honeymoon they never had.

videos.overview: When she and Candice face off against her oldest rival at Venice Beach, Pearle returns to her childhood roots as a Champion Sandcastle Builder.

videos.overview: The gang begs a seriously ill Alex to seek medical attention, but his fear of doctors causes him to avoid hospitals at all costs.

videos.title: Randy Free Solos

videos.overview: Josh gets Alex hired at Plugger-Inners for the summer but struggles to hide Alex’s incompetence from the boss.

videos.title: Bridgette the Brain
videos.overview: Bridgette and her sister Olivia’s lifelong rivalry comes to a head as they vie for their mother’s approval.

videos.title: Never Meet Your Heroes
videos.overview: Alex gets the opportunity to perfect his writing skills as an apprentice under his favorite author.

videos.title: Robots with Benefits
videos.overview: Fearing for their jobs, Josh and his coworkers must destroy their robot replacement.

videos.title: The Weird Kid
videos.overview: After worrying that she and Candice are growing apart, Emily magically becomes a kid again – and tries to befriend Candice at school.

videos.title: Legend of the Pier
videos.overview: Bridgette sets out to re-live her teenage glory days… but finds it’s far more difficult than she imagined.

videos.title: Bike & Survive
videos.overview: After Alex gets the latest home-exercise bike, the rest of the gang worry that he’s getting sucked into a cult

videos.title: Halloween Enough
videos.overview: When a thunderstorm makes trick-or-treating impossible, the gang tells Candice a trio of scary stories to save her Halloween.

videos.title: The Perfect Couple
videos.overview: When Alex and Bridgette get sick of kid-friendly activities, Josh and Emily seek out new like-minded parent friends.

videos.title: Match Made in Valhalla
videos.overview: Bridgette finds the perfect match for Alex… but has second thoughts when she realizes she still has feelings for him.
